verdict.rationale: A remote-desktop and screen-streaming product could plausibly publish a machine-readable spec, for example for its host protocol or a control API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such spec: probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and the docs describe no API, account or server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
